notes.title: Radio
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947671/492a76c9ea2f94695eea35bd2dbf464ed993e229.jpg[/img]


Living in the 1970s must've been an experience in itself. All the world around us was changing. 
So many reforms and change
- Social
- Technological
- Economical
- Borders just to name a few.

Radio was a big part of everyone's life in the 1970s.
They had hand radios, radios in their bicycles, cars everywhere. I had to put a radio system in the game so here it is.



During the 1970s music was huge, bigger than television if I may say so. The top genre were Jazz, Smooth Jazz, Jazz Fusion, Jazz Blues, Disco, Funk. 

During this time two new genres were rising : Rock and Hip-Hop(in the USA).

The radio plays 2 stations and 1 station needs to be unlocked in game. 
Stations :

- Jezzy Station tuned at 93.5 (Jazz and Blues)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947671/bdebb932537ebc9c19f270f1c1b7a97c14ddbb5a.png[/img]

- Disco 99 Station tuned at 99 (Disco and Funk)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947671/2ad9c525a59b0944301eaea9754924004cc95880.png[/img]


- Rolla 104 Station tuned at 104 (Rock and Roll)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947671/8966708e73217d719b83c20748135fda2aada1b0.png[/img]


I wish to put in some voice acting but they are pretty expensive, so right now its just music tracks.
